hypothesis: After hard safety gates, paired30-trial normal-network diagnostics quantify bounded snapshot transfer amplification and durable-settlement latency at10/1000 pages on both mock providers

source.sourceDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(manifest), preserving manifest insertion order

definitions.timing: Cold: after initial local fixture ACK through both stores inspected durable and pending settled; incremental: last local edit ACK through both stores inspected durable and pending settled; reconnect: restored connectivity through both stores inspected durable full conflicts and pending settled.
definitions.hydration: Second initially empty device imports the complete existing snapshot and commits its verification receipt.
definitions.bytes: HTTP body bytes only; headers, TLS and wire framing excluded. Amplification uses UTF8 full replacement Markdown body bytes, not text delta or protocol metadata.
definitions.backend: Node native RxDB/Dexie with fake-indexeddb; separate real Chromium IndexedDB crash correctness evidence. Synthetic8ms RTT/2ms jitter, not measured Google/WebDAV latency.
definitions.cpu: Node process CPU including harness/oracle work; heap observations are not peak memory or isolated database footprint.
definitions.failures: All attempted rows retained. No percentile eligibility with non-PASS rows or fewer than30 completed paired rows per cell. Browser/OS/power-loss and real-provider validation remain separate.
